    'emitted_at': '2026-04-28T12:00:00Z',
  },
}
validator.validate(base)
missing = dict(base)
missing.pop('bypass_record')
try:
    validator.validate(missing)

files_changed_self_report.rationale: Hardened bypass env propagation against GITHUB_ENV injection and added structured bypass summary emission.
Normalized waiver expiry to RFC3339 for summary/audit use and aligned date-only expiry validation to UTC.
Added `bypass_record` and an if/then requirement when `bypass_emitted` is true.

self_reported_concerns: I left the existing `waivers_applied` artifact shape unchanged because the user-requested R2 MAJ closure was specifically about structured `bypass_record`; expanding `waivers_applied` to support date-time expiries would be a separate schema change.
codex_structured_result.summary: Read the required WP-SCP-020, WP-SCP-022, and fix-round-1 safety review sections, then closed both open R2 MAJ safety_bypass findings within the allowed scope. The workflow now rejects newline/carriage-return control characters in bypass rule IDs and writes dynamic bypass metadata to GITHUB_ENV via unique-delimiter heredoc entries, eliminating newline injection. The bypass pairing script now emits a normalized RFC3339 waiver expiry timestamp, and the policy summary schema/workflow now include a structured conditional `bypass_record` with `rule_id`, `decision_id`, `waiver_expires_at`, and `emitted_at` whenever `bypass_emitted` is true. All requested verification commands passed.
